# Accessibility browser review

## Objective
Review the live application using its accessibility representation and keyboard interactions.
## Required context and areas
Start the local app; inspect labels, roles, names, headings, keyboard order, focus, validation messaging, error association, and semantic controls.
## Change constraints
Review-only; do not claim WCAG conformance or change code without a separate request.
## Response format
Observation, page/control, browser accessibility evidence, keyboard action/result, potential impact, confidence, human check, candidate test.
## Assumptions
Distinguish browser automation output from assistive-technology and human assessment.
## Validation and evidence
Record what was actually tested, screenshot/trace references, unresolved concerns, and human reviewer. Do not use implementation source until the initial browser observation is complete.
